title: JSFL fl.saveMappingFile missing from runtime
description:
fl.saveMappingFile(fileURI) is a Flash 8 JSFL standard method that writes an XML component-mapping file to disk. It is completely absent from both the JsflFl interface and the makeFlProxy return object in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts.

CONFIRMED: searching the entire codebase with grep -rn 'saveMappingFile' finds zero matches.

Impact: Any JSFL script calling fl.saveMappingFile() will throw 'fl.saveMappingFile is not a function'. This is called by Flash IDE extension scripts and some authoring automation scripts.

Fix: Add saveMappingFile(fileURI: string): void to the JsflFl interface (around line 4098 in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, near the end of the interface), and add a no-op stub implementation in makeFlProxy (around line 4303, near the end of the returned object) that warns to console: console.warn('[JSFL] fl.saveMappingFile: not supported in browser context'). In a browser environment there is no filesystem to write to, so a no-op with a warning is the correct implementation matching the pattern used for fl.browseForFileURL, fl.runScript, etc.

File: packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts
